registered-guests-upstairs.rule: No outside guests upstairs: the dorm floors are for registered guests, one to a pod.
registered-guests-upstairs.why: Everyone sleeps among people the house knows.

no-shoes-upstairs.rule: No shoes upstairs, on the dorm floors.
no-shoes-upstairs.why: Clean floors, as in most Lao homes.

front-door-locked.rule: The front door is locked from 23:30 until 07:00. Back late? Knock on the glass door and the night staff will let you in.
front-door-locked.why: The house stays locked while guests sleep, and someone is always there to open it.

pack-downstairs.rule: Leaving very early? Pack your bag on the ground floor.
pack-downstairs.why: So the dorm can sleep on.

leaving-before-eight.rule: Leaving before 08:00? Tell the team beforehand, so they can return your deposit.
leaving-before-eight.why: Check-out at the desk starts at 08:00.

quiet.rule: Keep your voice down at all times.
quiet.why: Most guests come here to sleep well.

says.door-in: In through the glass door on the left of the shopfront. From 23:30 to 07:00 it is locked: knock, and the night staff opens it.
says.check-in: Check in at the café counter, which is also the front desk: show your passport and pay the 100,000 kip deposit for your padlock and towel. Luggage can wait beside the desk.
says.shoes-off: Take your shoes off at the foot of the stairs and carry them up.
says.cubby: Leave your shoes in the cubbies on the Floor 1 landing.
says.take-shoes: Take your shoes and your bag; pack nothing in the dorm.
says.pack: Pack on the ground floor, beside the luggage space by the front desk, so the dorm can sleep on.
says.check-out: Check out at the front desk and get the 100,000 kip deposit for your padlock and towel back. Leaving before 08:00? Tell the team beforehand, so they can return your deposit.
says.water: Free drinking water at the dispenser, at the start of the corridor, with glasses in the cupboard below.
